changelog: ⚡ Phase 5 Upgrade: Ultra-Fast Native Code Syntax Highlighting in `libantibot_native.so` for 120 FPS typing in IDE Editor & Chat CodeBlocks.
🚀 Zero-Allocation Lexer: Single-pass DFA tokenization replaces 10 heavy Java regex passes, eliminating Dalvik GC pauses during editing.
✨ Multi-Language Native Highlighting: Full support for Kotlin, Rust, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, JSON, HTML, SQL, Shell, and PascalCase semantic typing.
